For bridal beauty shopping in the Gulf (GCC), these are consistently solid, “safe” picks (good brand selection + reliable delivery/returns in the region):

- **SEPHORA Middle East (online)** – Best if you want prestige makeup/skincare and bridal staples (long-wear foundation, setting sprays, lashes, minis for a bridal kit). Sephora runs dedicated Middle East country sites. ([sephora.com](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/international-websites?msockid=008a422fe04265bc35c454ace1af64f5&utm_source=openai))  
- **Nice One (KSA + Gulf)** – One of the biggest regional e-commerce beauty players; strong for makeup, skincare, and **perfumes** (great for bridal fragrance shopping). ([group.niceonesa.com](https://group.niceonesa.com/en?utm_source=openai))  
- **Faces (Chalhoub-backed)** – Another major GCC beauty destination; useful to compare against Nice One on price/promos and overlapping brands. ([hassalna.com](https://www.hassalna.com/en/uae/blog/nice-one-vs-faces-online-beauty-gulf?utm_source=openai))
